summary: Limited query access to customer payloads for billing-dispute audit
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (internal billing team) flagged a potential charge discrepancy for account ACCT-9932. They request a minimal set of customer payloads and inferred billing tokens for the time window 2026-02-18 00:00Z to 2026-02-19 04:00Z to validate a spike in token usage.

Impact:
- Customer-facing billing team cannot complete their reconciliation.
- Sensitive customer content may be included in inference payloads; access must be tightly scoped and redacted where possible.

Environment:
- Production inference logs (us-east-1) stored in secure logging cluster.

Request details / Scope:
- Return up to 20 raw request payloads (user prompt + metadata) matched to ACCT-9932 within the time window.
- Do NOT include full model outputs; include only token counts, model_id, request_id, timestamp, and a redacted prompt where PII is masked.
- Provide an audit trail of who accessed the data and which redaction rules were applied.

Steps taken so far (by reporter):
1) Verified billing ledger spike at 2026-02-18 05:12Z.
2) Queried aggregated token metrics (no PII returned).
3) Submitted this internal request for selective payload access and approval.

Required approvals: Legal / Privacy sign-off and SRE confirmation of extraction method.

Desired ETA: 2026-03-13 for initial sample delivery (customer-facing deadline from billing).
comments: 2026-03-10 10:14 - Jordan Kim: Acknowledged. Assigning to SRE to propose extraction method and to Privacy for review. Will scope to 20 payloads with automated redaction.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Priya Shah (Privacy): Please confirm whether we can use automated PII masking (name, email, phone, credit card patterns). If prompts include attachments or encoded blobs, we will need manual review.

2026-03-10 11:45 - Alex Rivera (SRE): Proposed approach: run a timeboxed query on logging cluster with filter account_id=ACCT-9932 and time range, export request metadata + verbatim prompt to a temporary, encrypted S3 bucket with server-side KMS key. Apply redaction lambda to mask PII patterns, then generate sample CSV containing token_count, model_id, request_id, timestamp, and redacted_prompt. Access will be via a time-limited signed URL. Need Privacy sign-off and Exec approval for KMS use.

2026-03-11 09:22 - Priya Shah (Privacy): Approved automated PII masking for name/email/phone/SSN patterns. Do NOT export any base64 blobs or attachments. Any prompts flagged by the mask as uncertain must be escalated to Privacy for manual redaction.

2026-03-11 10:05 - Legal (Elena Moreno): Legal approves disclosure under internal audit rules if scope is limited and audit trail retained. Require confirmation that no raw model outputs are included.
2026-03-12 08:41 - Jordan Kim: Extraction job scheduled for 2026-03-12 14:00Z. SRE to post a sample manifest before delivery. Billing team notified of expected ETA.
investigation_notes: SRE checked logging retention and found full request payloads are available for the time window. Initial token accounting matches billing spike. Risk analysis: prompts sometimes include developer debugging snippets that can contain API keys in rare cases; redaction lambda will run regex to scrub common API key patterns and require manual review for blobs. Temporary S3 will have bucket policy restricting access to a small allowlist and object lifecycle set to auto-delete after 72 hours.
resolution: In progress. SRE executed extraction and redaction pipeline as approved. Preliminary manifest (list of 20 request_ids with redaction status) posted to the ticket. Final delivery pending Privacy manual reviews on 3 items flagged as ambiguous. Billing team has been given a preview of token-counts via secure dashboard; full redacted sample will be delivered after manual approval expected 2026-03-13.
follow_up_actions: Privacy to complete manual review of 3 flagged prompts and confirm redactions
SRE to delete temporary S3 bucket and provide final audit trail (who accessed, KMS key id, S3 object keys) once delivery is complete
Create a short SOP for future billing-related payload requests to reduce manual touchpoints
